About our BIO Core – Systems Infrastructure Engineer 

BioTuring is an innovative bioinformatics company that develops algorithms, and agentic AI software to serve scientists from hundreds of pharmaceutical companies and leading research institutions, enabling discoveries about human diseases.

Our annual program trains you to design and operate the Cloud/HPC infrastructure behind frontier AI in biology – setting the technical direction for how BioTuring brings massive computation to cure diseases.

What awaits you at the BIO Core 2026

  • Starting salary from VND 25M gross during 5 months of intensive training.
  • 1:1 coaching from an industry PhD, own and build the advanced computing infrastructure that understands biology for curing diseases.
  • Accelerated career path for high-performers with a direct transition to Full-Time Employee (FTE).
  • Effective, fast, sustainable and high ownership working environment.
  • Company-sponsored international travel to attend prestigious Systems Infrastructure Workshops.

Are you our ideal candidate?

  • Networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, routing, subnetting, infiniband).
  • Comfortable on the command line, good system administration (processes, filesystems, permissions).
  • Excellent knowledge in Linux and computer architecture.
  • Used Docker or a VM at least once — curious about what runs underneath.
  • Minimum basic knowledge of SSH keys, firewalls.
  • Python or Bash with an automation mindset.
  • Background in either Computer Science/Systems Engineer/Infrastructure Engineer/Electrical Engineer or related field.
  • Open to Students, Bachelor’s, Master’s, and PhD or self-taught engineers.
  • Open to local and expat (work permit sponsorship + relocation assistance provided).

Bonus if you have:

  • OpenStack, Ceph, Ansible exposure. 
  • Open-source contributions  in LLM- or security-adjacent repositories, Reported CVEs or bug bounties. 
  • Available to work full time and onsite in Ho Chi Minh city or Ha Noi from Dec 2026.

How will you join us?

  • Link: https://bioturing.com/careers/system-engineer-bio-core-2026/
  • Application deadline: 30 Nov 2026.
  • The BioTuring Test: 4-11 Dec 2026
  • Offer & Onboarding: Dec 2026.

What is your journey?

  • Incubation (3 months): Active participation — OpenStack, Ceph, Linux at production scale; Specialized coaching for professional advancement. 
  • Probation (2 months): Fast-track career progression. 
  • Final Transition: International Systems Infrastructure Workshop for high performers & Conversion to Full-time employee.
